events.title: Spin Doctors – Live at Kings Beach Tavern
events.description: The iconic 90s American alt-rock band, Spin Doctors, are playing a live show as part of their Australian tour. Expect a high-energy performance of their well-known hits.

events.title: Beachfest 2026 Trivia Day & Classic Car Showcase
events.description: A high-energy afternoon trivia event with over $1000 in prizes, complemented by an impressive display of 80+ pre-1984 classic cars. Gather a team for a fun social session.

events.title: Thursday Brain & Burger Trivia Night
events.description: Weekly trivia challenge at the Banana Bender Pub, hosted by Adam, with twists on classic trivia. Compete with friends while enjoying an optional burger and chips special.

events.title: Eumundi Markets (Wednesday)
events.description: Experience the unique and vibrant atmosphere of this iconic artisan market, featuring hundreds of stalls with handmade goods, local food, and live buskers. A great community outing.

events.title: Eumundi Markets (Saturday)
events.description: The larger Saturday edition of the iconic Eumundi Markets, offering a chance to discover local culture, artisan goods, fresh produce, and live performances in a bustling community setting.

events.title: NightQuarter Friday Night Markets
events.description: An entertainment precinct offering regular night markets with food vendors, unique stalls, and a lively atmosphere. Features the Enchanted Garden and various performance spaces.

events.title: NightQuarter Saturday Night Markets
events.description: The Saturday edition of NightQuarter's popular weekly markets. Enjoy food, live music, and unique vendors across distinct zones like The Enchanted Garden and the Eumundi Backyard.

events.title: XACTO (XTC Tribute) + Crack That Whip
events.description: A new wave extravaganza featuring XACTO, Australia's premier XTC tribute band, alongside the electrifying Crack That Whip. Enjoy live music in The Presynct's unique steampunk Art Deco venue.

events.title: The Grogans – Live on the Sunshine Coast
events.description: Melbourne trio The Grogans return to the Sunshine Coast, delivering their signature blend of laid-back surf rock and gritty garage energy. Check the council's events page for confirmed date and venue.

events.title: Steve Kilbey (The Church) – An Evening With…
events.description: An intimate solo performance from Steve Kilbey, the iconic frontman of The Church, featuring his 12-string guitar and extensive songwriting catalog. Doors typically open at 7:00 PM.

events.title: The Jazz Room – Live Jazz
events.description: A recurring live jazz session for lovers of classic and improvised jazz. Expect a feel-good, intimate, and authentic musical evening at a local Sunshine Coast venue.

events.title: Trail Run Australia – Sunshine Coast
events.description: One of the Sunshine Coast's most scenic and challenging trail running events, attracting enthusiasts from across Australia. A great outdoor community event for adventure-minded individuals.

events.title: 80s Maroochy River Cruise
events.description: A fun, social, themed river cruise celebrating 80s music and culture on the Maroochy River. Expect a lively atmosphere and a unique evening on the water.

events.title: Solbar – Weekly Live Music
events.description: Solbar offers a packed schedule of live music across its intimate lounge bar and high-energy Band Room, showcasing local and national artists, as well as visual art exhibitions. Check their website for specific lineup this week.

events.title: Kings Beach Tavern – Weekly Live Music
events.description: One of the Coast's biggest live music destinations, offering a regular line-up of entertainment in the Beach Bar and a relaxed deck with ocean views. Check their website for this week's acts.

events.title: The Presynct – Open Mic Night
events.description: Regular Open Mic nights hosted at The Presynct, Nambour's unique steampunk Art Deco venue. A welcoming space for local musicians and performers to showcase their talents and connect with the community.
